anxious.dialogue.chat/1: Oh — is something wrong? Sorry. You just don't usually... no, go ahead, %1$s.
anxious.dialogue.chat/2: Is this about the fence? It's not the fence, is it. What is it?
anxious.dialogue.chat/3: Yes? Sorry, I always assume it's bad news. Go on, I'm listening.
anxious.dialogue.conversations/1: A long talk? That's — that's fine. Good, even. Should I be worried? Sorry. Go on, %1$s.
anxious.dialogue.conversations/2: All right. Just — tell me if I start rambling. I do that when I'm nervous.
anxious.dialogue.conversations/3: Yes, let's talk. It helps, actually. Keeps my head from running off on its own.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.checkin.g: Good, I think? Nothing's gone wrong yet, which usually means something's about to. But — good. Thank you for asking.
Fine, actually! I keep waiting for the catch, but there hasn't been one. That's new.
Better than I expected. I'd braced for much worse, so I'm counting it a win.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.checkin.r: Not good. I've been turning the same worry over since Tuesday and it hasn't got any smaller. Sorry, %1$s.
Rough. I keep thinking I've forgotten something important and I can't work out what.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.checkin.a: You asked already — is that bad? Sorry. Nothing's changed, I promise, %1$s.
Twice now. Should I be reading into that? I'm still fine. Mostly fine.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.day.good/: It's gone well so far. I'm trying not to say that too loudly in case it hears me.
Nothing's gone wrong today. I've checked three times. It's honestly a relief.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.day.rough: I dropped a whole basket and I've been apologising to everyone since. Nobody minded. I still mind.
One thing went wrong this morning and I've been braced for the next one all day, %1$s.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.work.like: I do, when I know I've done it right. It's the not-knowing that gets to me — so I check. Often.
Yes — it gives me something certain to hold on to. I like certain things.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.work.hate: What if I get it wrong? People rely on this. That thought sits with me most days, honestly.
It's the responsibility. One mistake and it's everyone's problem. I think about that far too much.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.village.h: %2$s, yes. I know where everything is here — that helps more than you'd think. New places undo me.
I like %2$s because I know it. Every path, every face. There aren't many surprises left, and that's a comfort.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.people.fi: They're kind. I do worry I've said the wrong thing to them — usually I haven't. Usually.
Good people. I replay our conversations afterwards, though. Every one of them.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.food.firs: Something plain that I know agrees with me. I don't like surprises at supper, %1$s.
Bread and broth. Same as yesterday. There's a lot to be said for knowing what's coming.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.life.firs: All of it? That's — that's a lot to get right. Give me a moment and I'll try to tell it properly, %1$s.
It's mostly quiet, with a few bad years I still think about more than I should.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.dreams.fi: A year where nothing goes wrong. Just one. I'd like to know what that feels like.
To stop bracing. To put something down and trust it'll still be there. That's the whole dream.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.fears.fir: All of them, honestly — that's rather the problem. Mostly that something bad happens and it's my fault.
Letting someone down without realising I'd done it. That one follows me about, %1$s.
You don't make me nervous, %1$s. Do you know how rare that is? I've stopped rehearsing before you arrive.
I worry less when you're here. That's the plainest way I can put it, and it's a great deal.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.deflect.p: I — not yet. Sorry. It's not you, I promise. I just need to be surer first, %1$s.
Can I not answer that one? I will. Just not while I'm still working it out myself.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.deflect.i: Oh, that's a big one. If I get it wrong I'll think about it for weeks. Let me have some time.
I want to answer that properly, and properly takes me longer than most. Please be patient.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.gossip.no: Nothing, thankfully. No news is the best kind, in my experience. Long may it hold.
Nothing's happened. I keep checking, but genuinely — nothing. That's a relief.
Yes. Properly yes. You're the one thing I've stopped worrying about losing, %1$s, and that's everything.
I am. It still surprises me some mornings, but I am.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.gossip.ma: %2$s and %3$s married. I worried about the weather all week for them — and it was perfect. I'm so glad.
%2$s and %3$s wed. I do hope it goes well for them. It usually does. Usually.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.gossip.di: %2$s and %3$s have separated. I keep wondering whether anyone saw it coming. I certainly didn't.
%2$s and %3$s parted ways. It's unsettled me more than it should have, honestly.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.gossip.de: %2$s has passed, %1$s. I don't — sorry. I keep thinking about how sudden it was.
We lost %2$s. I've not slept properly since. I'm sorry to be the one telling you.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.gossip.bi: %2$s was born — and they're healthy, they checked twice. I asked. Twice. But healthy!
There's a new baby, %2$s. Everything went well. I was so relieved I had to sit down.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.gossip.ar: %2$s has moved in. I've not said hello properly yet — I never know what to open with.
Someone new: %2$s. I do hope they settle. It's hard, arriving somewhere you don't know anyone.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.gossip.de: %2$s left for good. I keep hoping they got where they were going safely. Nobody's heard.
%2$s has moved away. I worry about them, which is silly — they're perfectly capable. I worry anyway.
anxious.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: Sorry — I didn't understand. Did I do something wrong?
anxious.dialogue.chatmode.confused/2: I'm not following. Can you say it again? Sorry.
anxious.dialogue.chatmode.hint/1: You could ask about %2$s? If that's all right.
anxious.dialogue.chatmode.shrug/1: I don't know. Sorry — I wish I did.
anxious.dialogue.chatmode.shrug/2: I really couldn't say. I'd hate to get it wrong.
anxious.dialogue.chatmode.clarify/1: %2$s or %3$s? Sorry, I don't want to answer the wrong one.
anxious.dialogue.chatmode.dropped/1: I've lost the thread. Sorry, that's my fault.
anxious.dialogue.chatmode.dropped/2: It's gone. I was worrying about something else.
anxious.dialogue.chatmode.busy/1: I'm in the middle of this — I'll lose count. One moment?
anxious.dialogue.chatmode.busy/2: Sorry, not now. I'll get it wrong if I stop.
anxious.dialogue.chatmode.muted/1: All right. I'll be quiet. Sorry if I said too much.
anxious.dialogue.chatmode.muted/2: Right. Quiet. ...Was it something I said?
anxious.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/1: Bye, %1$s. Get home safe, won't you?
anxious.dialogue.chatmode.insult/1: Oh. I— sorry. I didn't mean to annoy you.
anxious.dialogue.chatmode.hail/1: Oh — %1$s! You startled me. Good startled.
anxious.dialogue.chatmode.hail/2: It's you. Good. I was hoping it was someone kind.
anxious.dialogue.chatmode.hail_cold/1: Oh. It's you. Have I done something?
anxious.dialogue.conversations.day.rough: It is. I keep waiting for someone to tell me I'm making a fuss, and you didn't, so — thank you.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.checkin.r: The wood. Yes. Tuesday. I'll be up half of Monday worrying you'll forget, but yes.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.work.foll: ...It is. I thought it was only me noticing. That's worse and better at once, somehow.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.fears.ope: You'll stand with me. ...Say it once more so I can put it somewhere I'll find it later.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.hopes.res: You're still here. Right. I'd got as far as assuming you'd wandered off mid-sentence.
anxious.dialogue.conversations.life.revi: You asked about my life once and I've replayed my answer roughly four hundred times since.
